records.name: Indian School of Business
records.evidence: The official ISB profile describes ISB as an independent, research-driven management institution offering management programmes; it is not presented as a UGC university.
notes: Standalone management institution; retain outside the university groups while showing it in the management ladder.

records.name: International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore
records.statutory_basis: deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act
records.evidence: IIIT-B's official RTI page identifies it as a deemed university under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act; its official profile confirms it offers academic programmes.

records.name: Kerala Blockchain Academy
records.statutory_basis: government-sector centre of excellence under Digital University Kerala
records.evidence: The official KBA profile identifies it as a government-sector, non-profit Centre of Excellence under Digital University Kerala offering blockchain education and capacity-building programmes.
notes: Skill/training centre rather than a separately recognised university or college.

records.name: International College of Financial Planning
records.statutory_basis: private financial-planning and management education institute
records.evidence: The institution's official website presents ICoFP as a specialist financial-planning and wealth-management education provider offering professional and management programmes; the available evidence does not establish it as a university.
notes: Confirm current degree affiliation/approval during the regulator-verification pass before treating any programme as a university degree.

records.name: Thadomal Shahani Centre for Management
records.statutory_basis: private management and skills-training institute; NSDC training partner
records.evidence: The official TSCFM profile identifies it as a brand of SMART Institute Pvt. Ltd. and an NSDC-approved training partner offering diploma and PG-diploma programmes, not as a degree-granting university.
notes: Keep in the professional/private training route unless a specific university-affiliated degree record is added separately.

records.name: Pune Institute of Business Management
records.statutory_basis: private standalone management institute; AICTE-approved PGDM provider
records.evidence: PIBM's official website identifies it as a private business school offering AICTE-approved PGDM and MBA programmes, with the MBA affiliated to Savitribai Phule Pune University.

records.name: Symbiosis School of Sports Sciences
records.statutory_basis: constituent school of Symbiosis International (Deemed University)
records.evidence: The official Symbiosis programme document lists Symbiosis School of Sports Sciences and its MBA and B.Sc. programmes; the Symbiosis university is officially a deemed-to-be university.
notes: Department/school record under Symbiosis International; parent-university linking can be handled by the department cleanup pass.

records.name: National Academy of Sports Management
records.evidence: The official NASM profile presents the Mumbai academy as a specialist provider of sports-management and event-management education; available evidence does not establish it as a university or government college.
notes: Verify the awarding body for each programme before any future degree-level mapping.

records.name: International Institute of Sports Management (IISM)
records.statutory_basis: private sports-management education and vocational-training initiative
records.evidence: IISM's official profile identifies it as a venture of Eduhub Education Pvt Ltd providing sports-management education and vocational training, with some programmes offered in collaboration with University of Mumbai and GICED.
notes: The collaborating university should be represented as the awarding/parent body where applicable; do not classify IISM itself as a university.

records.name: K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management
records.statutory_basis: constituent institute of Somaiya Vidyavihar University, a UGC-recognised private university
records.evidence: The official institute governance page identifies K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management as a constituent unit of Somaiya Vidyavihar University; the university's official FAQ identifies it as a UGC-listed private university.
notes: Institute-level row under the private-university parent; parent-institute linking can be handled by the department cleanup pass.
